title: Ikanos Weapons
description: Ikanos Weapons adds 7 unique weapons to Minecraft, each with a powerful right-click ability and custom crafting system using new materials.
body:
New Materials
Before crafting weapons, you'll need to craft a Concentration Table and smelt new ingots.

Concentration Table
Crafted like a Smithing Table, but with Diamonds instead of Iron:
![conceptration table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21aef2fceb7e0c37e7a85bfeb96cff32c1776160.png)


New Ingots (crafted in the Concentration Table)
Ingot	Recipe
Cast Iron Ingot	= Iron Ingot + Diamond
Water Ingot	= Diamond + Lapis Lazuli
Tumbanga Ingot = Copper Ingot + Gold Ingot
 

⚔ Weapons

🔩 Morgenstern

![Morgenstern](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c9447627c6ad256be929c4e49ab850def961b8d.png)


[RMB] Area Strike — deals 5 damage to all enemies within 5 blocks, sending a shockwave of particles.

🌿 Poison Sickle

![ Poison Sickle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cac2e6a789bca4f4c4f891009596ef1b838703a7.png)


[RMB] Poison Cloud — creates a toxic cloud, applying Poison II for 5 seconds to all enemies within 3 blocks.

🔥 Berserker Axe

![Berserker Axe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d93760c22e5123ecff3aa81c702bf527767cfd78.png)

[RMB] Rage — activates berserker mode for 6 seconds: Strength II + Speed II. ⚠ Cost: Wither I for the full duration.

🌊 Poseidon's Trident

![poseidon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8fb7b08ad486696aead2d6cd8e7789f27cf7e3b.png)

[RMB] Wave — launches all enemies within 5 blocks forward (dealing 3 bonus damage), while launching yourself backward.

⚡ Lightning Whip

![Lightning Whip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cb8a0e5a2acb2f34f151577ff504ffe2c03ae07.png)

 [RMB] Chain Lightning — strikes the nearest enemy, then chains to up to 4 additional targets (damage ×0.75 per jump).

👁 Shadow Sickle

![Shadow Sickle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f42ed35d054e9cb621496c91d9318268eeb16aed.png)

[RMB] Teleport — teleports you behind the nearest enemy in your line of sight (up to 12 blocks), then deals a 8 damage backstab.

🔔 Doom Bell

 ![Doom Bell](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad36c31574cadcb48690c767a48541b8bcef944c.png)

[RMB] Toll of Doom — unleashes a sonic shockwave, applying to all enemies within 5 blocks:

Darkness II
Nausea II
Slowness I
Wither I
